title: Mild Downside Expected For Malaysia Stock Market
text:
Mild Downside Expected For Malaysia Stock Market November 25, 2018, 06:30: Malaysia stock market has inched higher in back-to-back trading days, although it has gathered just a half point or 0.04 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index remains just above the 1,695-point plateau although it figures to turn lower on KLCI finished barely higher on Friday following gains from the plantations, weakness from the telecoms and a mixed bag from the financial sector.
For the day, the index added 0.26 points or 0.02 percent to finish at 1,695.88 after trading between 1,689.14 and 1,696.54. Volume was 1.6 billion shares worth 1.1 billion ringgit. There were 597 decliners and 236 gainers.
